shots.title: Pick a browser, every time
shots.caption: Click a link anywhere and choose where it opens: a browser, a profile or a private window. Press 1 to 9, or click.

shots.title: Rules that pick for you
shots.caption: Send work sites to your work profile and links from Slack wherever you like. The first rule that matches wins.

shots.title: Every browser and profile
shots.caption: Add Chrome profiles and private windows as their own choices, and put them in the order you want.
